headline: 30 cars, 3 people and 1 truck went by; the camera could not see for 63 s.

bullets.text: Person passes close to moving car at 00:02.

honesty: The camera could not see for 63 s in total, in 3 stretches (56 s view blocked and 7 s blurry picture); the longest was 00:22 to 01:01. Anything that happened then is unknown.
Counts come from an automatic detector; one person or car can be counted twice if it was lost and found again.
8 more tracks hardly moved (less than their own width) and are not counted as going by.
"Busiest moment" at 00:39 falls in a stretch when the camera could not see well (blurry picture), so treat it with care.
